intro:
Almanac of artefacts and dimensional translations of titans.

"encyclopedia, an almanac of artifacts, of forgotten creations, of dimensional translations between titans and deities. The Beast. These artefacts, called Monsters, were part of the ancient titans, the sons of the Ideas (prirdial titans), as organs of the same. A titan"

sections.h: The Bestiary and the Lower Dimension
sections.t:
Librarii Ofel Isandarìa - a ring-shaped library, but titanic, as big as a planet. Here there are billions of books and/or pieces of information, including: the Bestiary (encyclopedia of the "Monsters", that is, of the magical artifacts)
 Il Bestiario - an encyclopedia on the Monsters, each with its own story, its inventor, and its section in the Library
Lower Dimension - A collapsed hyperverse that serves as the physical manifestation of Orpheus's body, simplified into one dimension.
The Stalkers' ability to integrate with other monsters (both human-made and anomalous in nature) has proven to be an invaluable asset. These creatures, referred to as "Monsters," serve as both distraction and combat support.
Kept in The Beyonder's shadow. — "…Quantum Physics. He wears Freya's falcon cloak and Aphrodite's girdle. He wears The Aegis in his left hand, and All Black The Necrosword in his shadow."

Addendum • Following that discovery, and the subsequent confirmation of the existence of higher narratives over the fictional universe, The Beyonders are currently the sole tribunal of all lower universes, in an executive position even higher than the SCP Foundation. The SCP Foundation has actively tried to cure The Beyonders. None of them has been successfully rescued.
Abilities • The Beyonder sacrificed his voice to inherit a fraction of The Marquis of Death's powers: he can speak the Word of Wyncham making any fictional character obey his orders; his power has cognitohazard effects on most conscious beings. The following is a list of all discovered species stated to be immune to his power: angels [DragonBall], na'vi [Avatar], red martians [Barsoom] [...].

However, The Beyonder appears to be in his 40s, although speculations analyzing his speech pattern suggest he was inexplicably born between 1500 and 1750 AD. sections.h: Technical observations of the Orem (Saints, Four Horsemen, story beats)
sections.t:
An ant is nothing compared to a praying mantis. But the same insect, if pitted against an entire anthill, would be completely annihilated. This was the main concept behind the theorem (the Orem), an organization of the lower creatures created to unite all creatures and defeat the gods. But there is still a big problem: if all creatures form an anthill, a single god is more like a diplodocus. But the Orem is not a simple anthill: its units attack the body of the gods like a virus. When the Created is at war with its own Creator, the mind collapses. The domain is no longer dominated by the Artist. The Orem studies the structure of the divine, of the pastures in the sky. It codifies its parts, in order to bring it to collapse. The council of the gods, the Wardogs (as the Machinist calls them, but as Ion Henri also called them), is composed of five fragments of the artist's childhood. Below I report some technical observations of the Orem.
[...] St. Elias Yensid, military God of the concrete environment. The hand of the artist. The absurdity of drawing. The concertante skill. The god owns a.44 calibre Remington Magnum, whose bullets have anomalous properties. Some bullets contain different things, such as objects, materials, organisms and concepts. He can shoot himself. He can shoot a hydrogen bomb. He can shoot your memories, erasing them. He can shoot you from the future. He can shoot the entire domain. He can pierce my head. If he vanished, the Artist's hand would cease to work. St. Maelstrøm Maelstrøm, military God of abstract defence. He is the inventor, the director, the magician. His projects rewrite the domain itself. The structure varies, changing according to his vision. He defends the mind, and acts following terror. St. Goitsebeng Bomaye, military God of logistics. He is the executor, the executioner. He shapes the soul, morality, and stops it when it goes too far. St. Messiaen Jay Shuha, military God of law. A failed spirituality, which existed in its time, and which perhaps will return in the future. Ste. Namygal Caesar, military goddess of agriculture. The Storm Dragon. She represents the artist who fights adversity up to the stars. She cultivates herself and her own ambition. Ste. Hecátekáli, Executioner. Hecate

Phasis' sword that turns a planet to ice.

"weapons through a horn. Phasis, Death Carrier is the commander of the 1st division. His favorite weapon is Diamonds Are Forever, a sword made of diamonds and ice, an artifact that can extract from any part of his body. The artist thinks of every single way"

A diamond mould forged into a sword. On contact with any material it expands its structure, so the surroundings become diamond slabs that can be mined. The wielding arm slowly turns to diamond, and wounds spread into diamond almost instantly; the wielder keeps a diamond arm for life. Its owner is the knight Phasis, bearer of death and the ice woman.

The Author's chosen fate in the paracosm.

"Author: I don't want to kill anyone, nor do I want violence. Therefore, the best option for me would be Willbreaker."

Editor: If you could take one artifact from your world, which would it be and why?
Author: I don't want to kill anyone, nor do I want violence. Therefore, the best option for me would be Willbreaker.

Willbreaker: touching it inspires fear; it pierces the victim's will. Touching the hilt makes victims see themselves cut even while it is sheathed. Partly unsheathed, it breaks the will of everything around it, objects included. Nobody has seen it fully extended except the Watchmaker. Its owner and creator is Neuron.
Sword.
Swordbreaker.
Sword.
Timebreaker.
Sword that cuts or stops any sound.
Soundbreaker: cuts or stops any sound or music, and can break the sound barrier.
Elastic sword that reproduces the attack it receives.
Sympathy: an elastic sword that vibrates on impact, reproducing the attack by sympathy, or stronger.
Veined sword tied to the wielder's libido (explicit).
Bestia: a veined sword tied to the wielder's libido; it grows stronger with arousal.
Sword made from an actual black hole.
Singularity: a sword made from an actual black hole; the most powerful weapon for gravity magic.
Small dagger inflicting insane pain.
Painkiller: a small dagger that inflicts insane pain with every hit.
Sword that does not exist unless you believe in it.
Imaginary Axis: it does not exist unless you believe in it.
Sword that pierces the flaw of anything.
A Voice Behind Me: pierces the flaw of anything, breaking it. With use it breaks the user's own flaw, slowly corrupting them.
Lava sword burned by the flames of Hell.
Hellfire: a metal sword burned by the flames of Hell; a continuously melting lava sword giving off smoke and fire. How it can be wielded is unknown.
Destroyed sword scattered across the universe.
Broken One: a destroyed sword whose parts are scattered across the universe. Its power is unknown.

Sword forged by Adam from Ra's spine; it pierces Lucifero and opens the Breccia nel Tempo.

"In a legendary battle, Adam defeated Lucifero with Ra's sword, creating a breach in Time. Without it the two would have clashed infinity, without winner."

The narrator's black blade. — "…with the likes of Vegapunk and Germa 66. I learned swordsmanship. I fought with one of the Supreme Grade Swords, the black blade Lazarus. Suit powered by Amaterasu, Nabu, Gilgamesh, Esfandiyār and Laka. — "A.N.G.E.L. Suit, referred to as the "A.N.G.E.L. Suit," is a highly anomalous and divinely engineered exosuit. The suit is constructed from a combination of an aviator mask (including…"

Special Containment Procedures:
A.N.G.E.L. Suit is to be contained within a high-security, multi-dimensional vault located at Site-██. The device itself should remain inactive unless specifically authorized for testing or research under controlled conditions. Due to the divine nature of the suit’s components, only Level 4 personnel with prior approval from Dr. Daedalus may engage with or interact with A.N.G.E.L. Suit.
Access to the blueprint, which is located within an unknown space station orbiting the Armageddon Loop, is strictly prohibited unless necessary for continued study. Any unauthorized attempts to access the blueprint or activate A.N.G.E.L. Suit will result in immediate termination of access privileges, followed by a standard memory wipe procedure.

Description:
A.N.G.E.L. Suit, referred to as the "A.N.G.E.L. Suit," is a highly anomalous and divinely engineered exosuit. The suit is constructed from a combination of an aviator mask (including helmet, goggles, and oxygen mask) and a pair of wings derived from the divine entities known as seraphim. The wings, which are strapped to the user's back, are biologically and metaphysically connected to the suit’s power source.
The suit’s core design and functionality are based on five distinct divine entities, each bestowing extraordinary enhancements to the wearer. These attributes are as follows:
The Energy of Amaterasu: The suit’s power source, which provides an unquantifiable amount of energy. This energy is metabolized by the user, granting them superior physical and metaphysical capabilities.
The Wisdom of Nabu: Enhances the wearer’s cognitive functions, allowing them to understand and utilize the suit’s powers effectively.
The Strength of Gilgamesh: Endows the user with immense physical strength, enabling feats beyond normal human comprehension.
The Invulnerability of Esfandiyār: Provides near-invulnerability to the user within the paracosm, allowing them to withstand unimaginable physical and metaphysical stresses.
The Stamina of Laka: Grants the wearer an extraordinary ability to endure and process the immense energy produced by Amaterasu without succumbing to its destructive force.

Relentless hunter-armour forged in The Forge. — "The Stalker, commonly known as "The Stalker," is a small-sized automaton designed with a singular purpose: to track and neutralize a designated target object. Standing at 1.2 meters…"

Special Containment Procedures:
The Stalker, known as "The Stalker," must be contained in a high-security robotics facility equipped with electromagnetic fields capable of disrupting its internal guidance system. The Stalker is to be housed in a small, reinforced containment chamber, capable of sustaining extreme pressure and environmental conditions. Due to its autonomous nature and its relentless pursuit behavior, any attempts to stop the Stalker before it completes its mission must be handled with extreme caution.
Personnel tasked with interacting with The Stalker must undergo a thorough analysis of its tracking algorithm and mission parameters. Given its pursuit-driven programming, subjects should not be placed in close proximity to any identified target objects unless fully debriefed. Only authorized personnel are allowed to initiate deactivation protocols.

Description:
The Stalker, commonly known as "The Stalker," is a small-sized automaton designed with a singular purpose: to track and neutralize a designated target object. Standing at 1.2 meters tall, the Stalker is an intricate golem-like creation, composed of reinforced metal alloys and organic compounds, with several mechanical appendages designed for both mobility and offensive action. Despite its small size, the Stalker is capable of extreme precision and persistence, guided by a complex algorithm that directs its relentless pursuit until the target object is neutralized.
The Stalker operates autonomously, without any true consciousness, and is driven by an algorithm designed to hunt and destroy. The algorithm can be overridden or modified to target specific objects, and it is programmed to identify these targets with near-infallible accuracy. Upon detection, the Stalker will begin its pursuit and will not cease its actions until the object has been neutralized or destroyed.
The Stalker is powered by a rare and anomalous space fungus, which serves as both a biological and technological fuel source. The fungus is a form of organic energy storage that enhances the Stalker's computational capabilities, enabling it to adapt its tactics and strategies as required. This fungus has been linked to a number of unidentified extraterrestrial phenomena, and attempts to replicate it have failed.
